units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:3">Sabb. I, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 11a:10">11ᵃ</cite>) <he>ולא הלב׳ וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>הליב׳</he>) nor must the scribe go out (shortly before the beginning of the Sabbath) with his pen (behind his ear); Y. ib. 3ᵇ top.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 3:1">Gitt. III, 1</cite> <he>אמר לל׳ וכ׳</he> if one says to the scribe &c., v. <cite ref="B01277"><he>בְּרֵירָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 17b:10">Snh. 17ᵇ</cite> (among the requirements of a town in which a scholar should live) <he>רופא אומן ול׳</he> a physician, a surgeon and a clerk.—
Peah II, 6 נחום הל׳ (Ms. M. הבבלי); Naz. 56ᵇ נחום הל׳ Nahum the scribe; a. fr.—Pl. לִבְלָרִין, לִי׳.

<cite ref="Shabbat 11a">Sabb. 11ᵃ</cite>. [<cite ref="Shabbat 92b:9">Ib. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>שכן לִבְלָרֵי מלכות וכ׳</he> for the imperial scribes carry their bags that way; prob. to be read <he>טַבְלָרֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="I00074"><he>טַבְלָר</he></cite>.]
